explorations.scope: Panel infrastructure, design token compatibility, existing API hooks, theme system
explorations.verdict: All 5 exploration areas show full compatibility. No blockers found.
key_findings: All design tokens map to existing CSS custom properties across 9 themes
CharacterTab already has relationship API integration — extend or reuse
EvaluationPanel provides the hook pattern for drill-down data access
Lazy-loading + Suspense pattern is established and well-documented in code

explorations.scope: Locked design direction, component specs, layout specs, animation tokens
explorations.verdict: Design spec is concrete and implementable. No ambiguities that would block planning.
key_findings: 5 panels have specific layout structures (timeline_table, categorized_grid, metric_row_grid, expandable_table, structured_list)
Animation tokens are production-ready with specific durations and easing curves
Badge semantic colors (success/warning/danger) use fixed rgba — no theme dependency needed
Spacing tokens (section_gap=16px, card_gap=10px, row_gap=0px, inner_padding=14px) are simple values
Accordion behavior specified: single-expand for Evaluation, multi-expand for Foreshadowing

resolved_decisions.resolution: CSS-based only — design spec uses no external visualization library. All layouts achievable with CSS Grid, Flexbox, and standard HTML elements.
resolved_decisions.evidence: design-tokens.json layout section uses CSS grid-template, flex, and standard HTML patterns

resolved_decisions.resolution: Right panel at 400px width, following existing AppRightPanels pattern
resolved_decisions.evidence: design brief constraint + AppRightPanels.tsx existing architecture

resolved_decisions.resolution: Single-expand for Evaluation Drill-Down, multi-expand for Foreshadowing Tracker

still_open.notes: Need to decide on key naming convention for panel labels, section headers, metric labels. Should follow existing i18n patterns in codebase.
Local component state vs Zustand store for panel data. Most panels consume API data directly — may only need local state for UI concerns (expand/collapse, filters).

new_gray_areas.description: Character Relationships could be a standalone right panel OR an enhanced tab within existing KnowledgePanel. Design spec says 'structured_list' in right panel, but CharacterTab already has relationship data. Need to decide integration point.
new_gray_areas.recommendation: Standalone panel that reuses existing API hooks from CharacterTab — keeps panel architecture clean

new_gray_areas.description: Design spec shows evaluator drill-down as a separate panel, but EvaluationPanel already exists with evaluation data. Need to clarify if this is a new panel or an enhancement to the existing evaluation view.
new_gray_areas.recommendation: New panel type that focuses specifically on drill-down/score analysis, distinct from the existing evaluation workflow
